purpose: Teach: まなざし/哀しい/長続き/パラパラ/ふい/呆然と/生れ/ただ今

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのまなざしは、いつも優しいのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know — Mei-sis always looks at you with such gentle eyes.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Speaks as if noticing something precious about him. Soft, unhurried pace. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、哀しい絵本読んで泣いちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I read this sad book and I cried.
lines.style: Small, open voice. The admission of tears without shame, just quiet honesty. Slight hesitation before the verb, like he's still feeling it. Looks up at her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんとお絵描き、長続きしてるね
lines.en: Sho, it's nice that you and Mei-sis keep drawing together like this.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment. Speaks slowly, savoring the thought. Tender but not pitying. The warmth of someone who notices what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き帳のページをパラパラめくったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I was flipping through the pages of my sketchpad so fast!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick rhythm on the middle of the line. A small laugh tucked underneath. The pride of showing her his work.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがふいにお迎えにいらしたわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad came to pick you up so suddenly today.
lines.style: Slight shift to present awareness. A touch of surprise, maybe a question underneath. Still warm but watching his reaction. A beat of noticing the shift in the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお話を聞いて呆然と座っていたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I just sat there listening to Grandpa's story. I couldn't move.
lines.style: Hushed, still caught in the memory. Slow pace. Words land like he's reliving it. Soft trailing-off, like he's still a little stunned.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが生れた頃のお写真、見せてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I want to show you a photo from when Mei-sis was born.
lines.style: Tender, intentional. A gentle offering. Slower pace on the central idea. Like she's inviting him into something personal and safe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ただ今帰ってきました!
lines.style: Bright return, eager and light. Quick, warm energy. The simple joy of coming home. A small breath underneath, like he's been looking forward to this.
